candidates.name: meow_angry_tableflip
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with black slit eyes, grey whiskers and an open red-brown mouth, with a brown wooden table tumbling out of the upper-left corner
candidates.why: A table flip is a verb frozen mid-action. The still is the weakest possible version of it — the highest motion debt in the set.

subtle.motion: the cat vibrates with rage in place, the table jitters 2px against the corner, and two short steam puffs rise from behind the ears

full.motion: the cat crouches in anticipation for 3 frames, launches upward as the table tumbles end-over-end out of the top-left corner, then lands and pants with the mouth open before resetting

candidates.name: meow_facepalm
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with a heavy black outline, eyes hidden behind a raised five-fingered paw pressed across its face
candidates.why: A universal reaction emoji where the comedy is entirely the timing of the paw landing.

subtle.motion: the paw stays down and the head sinks 6px lower into a slow sigh, then lifts back

full.motion: a 4-frame beat of open-eyed disbelief, then the paw swings up and lands with a squash on impact, the head recoiling downward before settling

candidates.name: meow_hiss
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with grey whiskers, a dark-brown slit eye and an open red-brown mouth, with a grey paw swiping in from the upper-left
candidates.why: Hissing is a sustained, naturally cyclic action, and the silhouette changes hard enough to read at 32px.

subtle.motion: the fur puff pulses, the whiskers splay wider on the out-breath, and the raised paw flicks at the wrist

full.motion: the body arches up, the ear pins back, the jaw vibrates through the hiss with a short puff of breath, then the whole shape drops back down

candidates.name: meow_highfive_team
candidates.subject: two flat-vector yellow blob cats in profile facing each other with dark outlines, pink tongues and grey whiskers, raised paws nearly touching, with orange impact shards radiating from the contact point
candidates.why: Two hands about to meet reads as unfinished, and celebration emoji get the most out of a loop.

subtle.motion: both cats bob in place with their paws hovering, and the orange impact shards pulse brighter on the down-beat

full.motion: both cats wind up away from each other, swing in and clap, the orange shards flash out at full size on the impact frame, then both recoil and reset

candidates.name: meow_idea
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with round black eyes and a smiling mouth, one paw raised with a finger extended, and a small yellow light bulb with radiating strokes floating above its head
candidates.why: The light-bulb motif is built for a flicker — the cheapest animation in the batch for the payoff.

subtle.motion: the bulb's radiating strokes flicker on and off in a two-step rhythm while the cat holds still

full.motion: the bulb pops on with a burst of longer strokes, the cat's eyes widen and the raised paw jabs upward once, then everything settles back

candidates.name: meow_dunno
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with large white googly eyes, a zigzag mouth and grey whiskers, both rounded paws held out palm-up at shoulder height
candidates.why: A shrug is a two-pose action and the still only shows one. Also one of the highest-volume Slack reactions.

subtle.motion: the shoulders and both paws rise 4px, hold for 3 frames, then drop back down

full.motion: a full shrug — paws lift high with a head tilt to one side, the googly eyes roll, then everything drops with a small bounce at the bottom

candidates.name: meow_melt
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with dark-grey oval eyes, a wavy zigzag mouth and thin sketchy paws, its body already sagging wide at the base
candidates.why: Already mid-transformation in the still — a loop simply completes the gag.

subtle.motion: the body slowly sags wider and lower, then re-inflates, with the eyes drifting down as it spreads

full.motion: the cat melts down into a flat yellow puddle over 18 frames, the face sliding to the surface, blinks once from the puddle, then springs back up into the original shape

candidates.name: meow_grumpy
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with angry black slanted eyes, a jagged frown, folded arms and small grey steam puffs at both ears
candidates.why: The steam prop is already drawn, and steam is the single most loop-friendly element in the library.

subtle.motion: the steam puffs rise, expand and dissipate at each ear on an offset cycle while the brows twitch once

full.motion: a slow simmer with the body swelling, building to a burst of steam from both ears on one frame, then the body deflates back to the resting pose

candidates.name: old-man-yells-at-cloud
candidates.subject: a cartoon elderly man in profile with a yellow face, wispy yellow hair, an open shouting mouth, a grey hand raised in a fist, and a blue outlined cloud icon in the upper-left corner
candidates.why: Shouting plus a shaking fist is two animatable verbs in one frame — and the same rig also covers cat-yells-at-cloud and old-man-yells-at-comcast.

subtle.motion: the raised fist shakes side to side and the jaw flaps open and shut on a three-frame cycle

full.motion: a full rant cycle — the fist pumps twice, the body leans in toward the cloud on each pump, and the cloud drifts slowly in the opposite direction for parallax

candidates.name: meow_sleep_zzz
candidates.subject: a flat-vector yellow blob cat with closed curved eyes, pink blush patches, a small open mouth and grey whiskers, with two grey Z letters floating up to the right
candidates.why: Breathing plus drifting Z's is the cleanest possible loop, and the drowsy reaction has no animated equivalent yet.

subtle.motion: the body rises and falls on a slow breath while the two Z's drift up and to the right, fading out and respawning at the mouth

full.motion: a full snore cycle — a deep inhale swells the body, a bubble inflates from the nose over several frames and pops, and the cat twitches once as the Z's stream upward
